text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are trading flat with minimal overnight momentum, suggesting consolidation rather than conviction in either direction. The Fear & Greed index at 73 (Greed) and climbing over the past week indicates retail confidence is rising, though BTC's dominance holding steady at 58.9% shows major capital isn't rotating heavily into alts yet. Volume at $60B is moderate; the modest gains in secondary assets like BNB (+7.1%) hint at selective rotations into layer-1 alternatives, but without broader participation from the Bitcoin-Ethereum pair.
